name: Mouse Battery Indicator
author: twoscott
description: Wireless mouse battery glyph with a detail panel

barWidget.description: Battery glyph for a wireless mouse, with a panel showing the exact percentage, charge state, and how long ago the device last reported.

schema.label: Device match
schema.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the UPower model and kernel path, e.g. "g pro" or "hidpp_battery_1". Leave empty to auto-detect. Set this when auto-detection picks nothing or picks the wrong device — run `upower -e` and `upower -i <path>` to see what your mouse reports.

schema.label: Low battery threshold (%)
schema.description: At or below this percentage the bar glyph and the panel reading switch to the theme's urgent colour.

schema.label: Show percentage in the bar
schema.description: Off by default so the bar stays icon-only. Right-click the widget to toggle.

schema.label: Hide when the mouse is off
schema.description: UPower drops the device when the mouse is switched off. Off keeps a dimmed slot in place instead of collapsing the bar — also the way to tell "mouse is off" apart from "no matching device was ever found".
